description: SMBus Address Resolution Protocol at the Device Default Address. Source: SMBus Specification v3.3 (12 May 2024, SMIF) §6.6 (Tables 5-10, Figs 54-60). Protocol decoder, not a part: decodes every command byte 0x00-0xFF: general 0x01-0x04; directed Get UDID (odd) / Reset Device (even) for every legal target 0x08-0x77 except 0x0C and 0x61; reserved codes 0x00, 0x05-0x0F, 0xFE, 0xFF (write and read); directed forms aimed at reserved targets labelled as such. Enumerated because rules match exact command bytes. Directed codes 0x10-0x1F (targets 0x08-0x0F) fall inside Table 10's reserved 'general' range 0x05-0x1F and are decoded as directed. UDID is MSB-first on the wire. Payload includes the SMBus byte count; trailing PEC excluded from data_bytes. Notify ARP Controller travels to the Host (0x08): see smbus_host_notify_decoder.json. Generated by build_smbus_decoders.py — regenerate, do not hand-edit.

rules.name: ARP: Prepare to ARP
rules.description: Cmd 0x01, Send Byte + PEC (§6.6.3.2). All ARP devices ACK and clear AR; cancel pending Notify ARP Controller. Every ARP packet carries a trailing PEC byte (§6.6.3); it is not modelled in data_bytes and is checked by the tool's PEC option.

rules.name: ARP: Reset Device (general)
rules.description: Cmd 0x02, Send Byte + PEC (§6.6.3.3). Clears AR; AV cleared for non-PTA, set for DTA. ARP-function reset only. Every ARP packet carries a trailing PEC byte (§6.6.3); it is not modelled in data_bytes and is checked by the tool's PEC option.

rules.name: ARP: Get UDID (general)
rules.description: Cmd 0x03, Block Read + PEC (§6.6.3.4, Fig 56). Only devices with AR=0 respond. Payload: count 0x11, UDID bytes 15..0, target address. Every ARP packet carries a trailing PEC byte (§6.6.3); it is not modelled in data_bytes and is checked by the tool's PEC option.
